purpose: Evidence pack for the fifth bounded manual review batch. These are proposed relevance decisions only and do not alter the terminal IGOD assessment state or authorize publication.

rows.authorityName: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (MoAFW)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund operational guidance: eligible beneficiaries, post-harvest and farm-gate infrastructure, interest subvention, credit guarantee, project conditions, and application route
rows.rationale: The ministry portfolio includes agriculture infrastructure finance and enterprise-support routes directly relevant to agri-businesses, FPOs, cooperatives, startups, and infrastructure developers.

rows.evidenceAnchor: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana: micro-enterprise lending categories, eligible borrowers, lending-purpose coverage, and participating financial-institution route
rows.rationale: The ministry portfolio includes financial-inclusion, credit, guarantee, and lending-policy routes that are central to self-employed founders and small businesses.

rows.evidenceAnchor: ESIC Unified Shram Suvidha Portal registration manual: employer registration, establishment details, contribution and compliance workflow, and official handoff
rows.rationale: The ministry portfolio includes employer registration, social-security compliance, and establishment obligations that are required for growing businesses and their workers.

rows.evidenceAnchor: Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme FAQ: rural enterprise support, community resource persons, financing linkage, eligibility context, and implementation route
rows.rationale: The ministry portfolio includes rural entrepreneurship, self-employment, livelihood, and enterprise-support routes for founders and micro-businesses outside major urban centres.

rows.authorityName: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes: eligible beneficiaries, credit-support structure, implementing route, and scheme conditions
rows.rationale: The ministry portfolio includes targeted credit, entrepreneurship, and livelihood-support routes for eligible founder categories and disadvantaged entrepreneurs.

rows.evidenceAnchor: NIDHI+ guidelines: tourism-service-provider registration, eligible accommodation and hospitality categories, documents, verification, and renewal or update context
rows.rationale: The ministry publishes registration, recognition, standards, and hospitality-support routes relevant to tourism businesses, accommodation providers, and travel-service operators.

rows.evidenceAnchor: Ministry programmes and schemes page: cooperative-sector assistance, NCDC financing and enterprise-development routes, and programme navigation
rows.rationale: The ministry portfolio includes cooperative enterprise, producer organisations, financing, infrastructure, and business-development routes that are relevant to cooperative founders and member-owned businesses.

rows.evidenceAnchor: Updated Central Sector Scheme guideline for AYUSH hospitals and day-care centres: eligible organisations, project requirements, proposal route, release conditions, monitoring, and stated validity requiring current-status verification
rows.rationale: The ministry publishes sector-specific grant and infrastructure-support routes relevant to AYUSH hospitals, day-care providers, and eligible organisations; current validity must be verified before any opportunity is published.
